_comment: Bundles of the phone profile. Left out on purpose (each needs a program the phone cannot launch, a desktop, or a local speech/phone feature): @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code, @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex (CLI binaries), @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle, @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-terminal-bundle (PTY), @local/kybernos-workers (CLI workers), @local/kybernos-modeles-locaux (local model servers), @local/kybernos-call (voice agent), @local/kybernos-changes (git). Included on purpose: @local/kybernos-mobile (the phone layout the interface needs in the app; inside the app its phone-link half switches itself off and a « The Kybernos app » page takes its place).
